sectors.ai: Indonesia's consumer sector underperformed the US by 3.08% today, but selective mid-cap names like AGAR (+24.75%) and KLIN (+10.00%) signal rotation into value plays with strong domestic demand. Watch for further consolidation as the aggregate -0.80% masks divergent performance; position into household goods and food producers with pricing power to capture margin resilience amid stable inflation.
